verdict.line: You lose extended trades and solo kills in lane, but the 52.6% win rate over 363 games says you close the gap with items and win the game she can't.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's passive tentacles and 4-second-cooldown W (Harsh Lesson) mean every prolonged trade before level 6 favors her, which is why she holds the lane and solo-kill edge. Fiora's actual win rate comes from surviving that window, then using Q's double-dash reset and the threat of R (Blade Waltz) to punish her once tentacles stop deciding fights.

theirWindow.when: when her E lands and tethers you
theirWindow.what: Once the spirit is out, any damage you take also echoes onto you — disengage immediately rather than trading through it, and never let the spirit sit long enough to turn you into a Vessel that spawns tentacles on you permanently.

yourWindow.when: when her Q (Tentacle Smash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Q up she has no extra tentacle damage and Harsh Lesson alone is a much smaller trade. Use Q (Lunge)'s free second dash to hit-and-reset out of tentacle range before she can punish.

start.why: Highest pick and win rate start (51.1% over 401 games, 90.5% pick) — the lifesteal offsets chip damage from tentacles you can't fully dodge.

boots.why: 54.4% win rate over 281 games and 74.5% pick — Illaoi's damage is entirely physical auto/tentacle damage, so flat reduction outvalues tenacity here.

core.why: Sustain to match her tentacle-fed healing and wave clear to reset lane after bad trades.
Bumps your trade damage and mobility for the level 12-15 power spike where you start winning fights outright.
37.1%-pick, 60.7%-win path — delays her burst damage long enough for Duelist healing to catch up.

you're ahead by level 9-10 and want to force all-ins instead of waiting

runes.keystoneWhy: 43.5% win rate, the higher-performing of the two listed pages — stacks build off every short trade and auto you land, which suits a lane where you're mostly poking and disengaging rather than all-inning. Master-tier Fiora players (6,507 games) instead run Press the Attack for the burst window right after dodging her E — worth switching to once you're confident timing that dodge consistently.

summoners.why: 51.3% win rate and 91.5% pick rate — Ignite offsets her tentacle sustain in all-ins and secures kills once you land Blade Waltz at 6. Flash + Teleport (50%, 6% pick) is the alternative if you're playing for the level 11+ split push instead of lane kills.

playing.title: Never fight through her E
playing.detail: If she lands Test of Spirit, back off rather than trading — damage you deal echoes back onto you through the spirit, and staying tethered too long risks becoming a Vessel that spawns tentacles on top of you.

playing.title: Trade only in short bursts
playing.detail: Use Q (Lunge)'s free second dash to hit and immediately reset distance. Her W (Harsh Lesson) is up every 4 seconds, so any trade that runs long lets her land it twice.

playing.title: Punish her Q cooldown
playing.detail: Tentacle Smash starts at a 10-second cooldown (down to 6s at max rank) — track when she's used it on minions or you, since her trade power drops sharply without it up.

playing.title: Hold W into her level 6
playing.detail: Save Riposte's attack-damage buff and parry for the burst window right as she hits 6, per OP.GG's matchup data — you want the parry available, not on cooldown from a earlier minion trade.

playing.title: Use E to disengage, not chase
playing.detail: Burst of Speed's attack speed and stacking move speed are for getting out of tentacle range after a trade, not for extending fights you don't need level 1-5.

playing.title: Avoid walls near her tentacles
playing.detail: Her passive spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain — fighting near walls she's already used lets extra tentacles swing at you on top of her own damage.

playing.title: Look to reset with R post-11
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force is online, Blade Waltz lets you delete an overextended Illaoi from range before she can get tentacles up — this is where your 52.6% win rate actually comes from.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade timings, cooldown reasoning, and lane plan are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Use [Q] to contest lane and gain control before reaching level 6. After reaching level 6, use [W] to block her (R).
